feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Go Compare owner Future eyes sale of business arm
articles.summary: The London-listed company which owns Go Compare, the price comparison platform, is exploring a sale of its business-to-business arm.

articles.title: Elliott spreads out with interest in KKR-backed Flora Food Group
articles.summary: The American investment firm Elliott Management is circling Flora Food Group, the spreads and margarines producer, amid signs that its owner is struggling to convince bidders to meet a €7bn (£5.8bn) asking price.

articles.title: FBI seizes $1.2bn stolen in Binance cryptocurrency hack
articles.summary: The FBI has seized more than $1.2bn (£910m) of cryptocurrency stolen from Binance last month.

articles.title: Warburg Pincus eyes takeover of small business lender iwoca
articles.summary: The private equity giant Warburg Pincus is circling iwoca, the fast-growing small-business lender which funds tens of thousands of British SMEs.

articles.title: Under-fire Poundland owner 'among suitors' for footwear chain Dune
articles.summary: The beleaguered owner of Poundland is among the parties who have been considering offers for Dune, the British footwear retailer, even as its biggest UK high street asset teeters on the brink of collapse.

articles.title: Poundland secures extended deadline for possible rescue
articles.summary: Crisis-hit Poundland has secured an extended deadline for a potential rescue amid political pressure for a solvent sale of the chain.

articles.title: Poundland bosses meet to decide firm's future
articles.summary: The directors of crisis-hit Poundland have held a board meeting to decide the company's future, Sky News has been told.

articles.title: Millions of pensioners start receiving up to £300 winter payment - what you need to know
articles.summary: Millions of pensioners in England and Wales are starting to receive between £100 and £300 as this year's winter fuel payment starts to land.

articles.title: Economy grows 0.7% in third quarter but slowdown looms
articles.summary: The UK economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter of the year, according to early official figures confirming a boost from AI investment.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange owner eyes multimillion pound pay hike for boss
articles.summary: The owner of the London Stock Exchange (LSE) is plotting a multimillion pound boost to its chief executive's pay package amid warnings by Britain's blue-chip companies that boardroom compensation risks falling further behind US peers.
